verdict.rationale: Turso documents an official MCP server that lets any MCP-capable AI agent manage organizations, databases and groups and run SQL on the user's behalf, so natural-language operation works through an external agent. Turso itself does not interpret natural-language commands; that depends on a third-party agent client. missing for 10: a built-in natural-language interface in Turso's own CLI or dashboard, documented examples of natural-language command flows, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect any MCP-capable AI agent and it can manage your Turso Cloud account — organizations, databases, groups — and run SQL, on your behalf.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.turso.tech/integrations/mcp
